text.tspan: Imports PDF receipts from selected files/folders into the existing receipts table. It OCRs each PDF using the documents
tool, extracts structured fields via an agent, checks duplicates (vendor+date+total+receipt_number), and supports two
run modes: preview-only (default) or automatic insert. It also supports configurable duplicate and missing-field handling,
provides progress updates, uses batched insertMany writes, and prints a clear summary with skipped/error files.

text.tspan: Imports PDF receipts from selected files/folders into the existing receipts table. It OCRs each PDF using the documents
tool, extracts structured fields via an agent, checks duplicates (vendor+date+total+receipt_number), and supports two
run modes: preview-only (default) or automatic insert. It also supports configurable duplicate and missing-field handling,
provides progress updates, uses batched insertMany writes, and prints a clear summary with skipped/error files.
